releaseNotes:
• System PATH Self-Healing: Guaranteed automatic recovery of Windows System32 and PowerShell in process.env.PATH, completely eliminating 'spawn cmd.exe ENOENT' on machines with damaged environment variables.
• Safe Direct System Binaries: Switched all system automation (registry auto-start, wscript, and PowerShell helpers) to absolute system paths.
• Tray & Settings Window Fix: Guaranteed Settings modal display when opened from the system tray menu or double click, fixing hidden window state.
• Sub-route Navigation: Fixed routing for sub-tabs (#settings?tab=updates) to correctly render SettingsModal.
• NSIS Auto-Updater File Lock Fix: Bundled custom NSIS process cleaner that automatically terminates any lingering application instances before unpacking, allowing seamless updates from v1.0.6 machines without blocking message boxes.
• Multi-language Chat Text Replace (F10): Reliable text replacement and focus restoration for all target languages.
